subject.title: Conversational agent lane wedges indefinitely: ingress events never reconcile (re-delivery storm on reconnect) + abort_embedded_run leaves owner lock unreleased (released=0)

question: Should the remaining scope for this issue be limited to bounded durable ingress replay, or should OpenClaw also add an operator-facing ingress inspect/drain/ack command now?
rationale: The core message-loss bug has an active implementation candidate, but the manual queue-drain verb would create a new public recovery workflow that maintainers should explicitly sponsor or split out.

options.title: Land bounded replay first
options.body: Review and land the active replay/dedupe PR, then close this issue and open a narrower operator-tooling issue only if maintainers want that CLI surface.

options.title: Require operator tooling here
options.body: Keep this issue open after the replay fix until an inspect/drain/ack recovery command is designed and implemented.

options.title: Reject current PR shape
options.body: Close or redirect the active PR and keep this issue open for a different maintainer-owned durable-ingress design.

recommendation.title: Land bounded replay first
recommendation.body: Review and land the active replay/dedupe PR, then close this issue and open a narrower operator-tooling issue only if maintainers want that CLI surface.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged run-lifecycle fix and already scoped the remaining durable-ingress/product-decision boundary in the issue discussion.
